results.name: Real development StrictMode loads the captured owner’s actual settings once without a duplicate editor or error
Unsaved settings survive tab changes and local cancellation restores the server snapshot without saving
The add dialog survives effect replay, cancels draft input and restores its opener after Cancel and Escape
Settings fit 390px and the block list and add dialog fit 320px
Both real management reads carry the captured owner, with no writes, chat sockets or runtime errors
